_about: The two rows at the top of notsus.net, above the twelve categories.
Adam set this order on 2026-11-08. Until then these rows were exactly what
the browser puts on its own home screen, read off src/index.html, and they
are no longer: same sites, different order. The app's home screen has not
been touched, so the two now differ. If they should match, src/index.html
is the file to change, and that ships in the app.
Every name here must also be in docs/catalog/featured.json, and the website
build fails if one is not. A site appears twice on the page, once up here
and once in its category, which is intended: these rows are the view when
nobody has typed anything, and they disappear the moment a filter is on.
The app's two headings do not map onto the catalogue's twelve categories.
Its Create holds Scratch (CODING), Photopea (ART), Tinkercad (CREATE) and
Google Docs (UTILITY), because a child thinks in 'making things', not in
our filing. That is the point of the rows.
scripts/sync-catalog.sh copies this file into the website, so this is the
one to edit. Changing the website's own copy is undone by the next sync.
